parameters.jsCode: const body=$input.first().json.body;const required=['product_name','changes'];const missing=required.filter(f=>!body[f]);if(missing.length)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'Missing: '+missing.join(', ')}}];const changes=Array.isArray(body.changes)?body.changes:[];if(changes.length===0)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'changes must be a non-empty array'}}];const audiences=['customers','internal','developers','executives'];const targetAudiences=Array.isArray(body.target_audiences)?body.target_audiences.filter(a=>audiences.includes(a)):['customers'];const formattedChanges=changes.slice(0,30).map((c,i)=>({id:c.id||('CHG-'+String(i+1).padStart(3,'0')),title:(c.title||'').trim().slice(0,150),description:(c.description||'').trim().slice(0,400),type:c.type||'improvement',impact:c.impact||'medium',affectedAreas:Array.isArray(c.affected_areas)?c.affected_areas:(c.affected_areas||'').split(',').map(a=>a.trim()).filter(Boolean),ticketRef:c.ticket_ref||''}));return[{json:{valid:true,productName:body.product_name.trim(),releaseVersion:body.release_version||'',releaseDate:body.release_date||new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],periodCovered:body.period_covered||'',changes:formattedChanges,targetAudiences,brandVoice:(body.brand_voice||'friendly and clear').slice(0,200),customerEmailList:body.customer_email_list||'',internalEmailList:body.internal_email_list||'',replyEmail:body.reply_email||null}}];

values.content: You write product changelog digests for different audiences. Customer-facing digests focus on benefits and outcomes, not technical details. Internal digests include implementation notes and what to watch for. Developer digests cover API changes and migration steps. Executive digests are brief and business-focused. Each version is written natively for its audience. Always respond in valid JSON only.
